+// artistFolder finds the common directory of the artist's media files.
+func artistFolder(albums model.Albums) string {
+	var dirs []string
+	for _, album := range albums {
+		dirs = append(dirs, album.Dirs()...)
+	}
+	return commonDirectory(dirs)
+}
+
+func commonDirectory(dirs []string) string {
+	if len(dirs) == 0 {
+		return ""
+	}
+	folder := filepath.Clean(dirs[0])
+	for _, dir := range dirs[1:] {
+		for {
+			rel, err := filepath.Rel(folder, dir)
+			if err == nil && rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
+				break
+			}
+			parent := filepath.Dir(folder)
+			if parent == folder {
+				return ""
+			}
+			folder = parent
+		}
+	}
+	return folder
+}
+
+func fromArtistFolder(folder string) sourceFunc {
+	return func() (io.ReadCloser, string, error) {
+		path, _ := artistImageFile(folder)
+		if path == "" {
+			return nil, "", nil
+		}
+		file, err := os.Open(path)
+		return file, path, err
+	}
+}
+
+func artistImageFile(folder string) (string, os.FileInfo) {
+	if folder == "" {
+		return "", nil
+	}
+	for _, candidate := range []string{folder, filepath.Dir(folder)} {
+		entries, err := os.ReadDir(candidate)
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		for _, entry := range entries {
+			match, _ := filepath.Match("artist.*", strings.ToLower(entry.Name()))
+			if !match || !model.IsImageFile(strings.ToLower(entry.Name())) {
+				continue
+			}
+			info, err := entry.Info()
+			if err == nil && info.Mode().IsRegular() {
+				return filepath.Join(candidate, entry.Name()), info
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return "", nil
+}
